**Interactive Music Player** is a Discord music bot that lowers the music as soon as someone speaks in the voice channel, then brings it back up once silence returns — with a real-time web dashboard to control everything.

_Bot Discord de musique qui baisse le son dès qu'une personne parle dans le salon vocal, puis le remonte au retour du silence, avec un tableau de bord web temps réel. Version française plus bas._

## Download

| System                         | File                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows 10 / 11                | `Interactive-Music-Player_0.0.1_x64-setup.exe`                                                             |
| Linux (any distribution)       | `Interactive-Music-Player_0.0.1_amd64.AppImage` — make it executable, then run it                          |
| Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives | `Interactive-Music-Player_0.0.1_amd64.deb` — `sudo apt install ./Interactive-Music-Player_0.0.1_amd64.deb` |

Node.js, FFmpeg and yt-dlp are bundled: nothing else to install. On first launch, the app walks you through creating the Discord application and pasting its token.

The Windows installer is **not signed**: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the fingerprint of every file, and each one was built by the public _Application de bureau_ workflow from this tag.

You can also run the bot from source with Node.js 22.12 or later: see the [README](https://github.com/WolfGang-PRoxa/interactive-music-player#installation).

## Highlights

- **Automatic ducking**: level, hold time and fade length are adjustable, and participants can be excluded.
- **Real-time dashboard**: full control, drag-and-drop queue, playlists, logs and statistics, in English, French, Spanish and German, usable from a phone.
- **Two playback modes**: in the voice channel, or in your own browser without disturbing the server.
- **Many sources**: YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music, local files and folders.
- **Preloading, crossfades, speed control and loudness (LUFS) levelling.**
- **Resume after restart**, at the exact position of the interrupted track.
- **Sharing**: guests reach the dashboard through a Cloudflare link, without opening a port.
- **Configuration in the dashboard**: the bot's settings are edited from the owner's settings panel, and secrets are never sent back to the browser.

The full history is in the dashboard's changelog and in [`changelog/en.md`](https://github.com/WolfGang-PRoxa/interactive-music-player/blob/main/changelog/en.md).

Node.js, FFmpeg et yt-dlp sont fournis : rien d'autre à installer. Au premier lancement, l'application guide la création de l'application Discord et la saisie de son jeton.

L'installeur Windows **n'est pas signé** : SmartScreen affiche « Windows a protégé votre ordinateur ». Cliquez sur **Informations complémentaires**, puis **Exécuter quand même**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` donne l'empreinte de chaque fichier, tous construits depuis cette étiquette par le workflow public _Application de bureau_.
